answer: Propose one vote per ID funding desalination at an island haven. Each ID funds a distinct 1 kWh pump run per epoch. Two independently operated meters sign ID-bound start/end readings. Validators check both signatures, 1 kWh deltas and disjoint intervals per pump. Thus n IDs require n kWh; shared equipment cannot reuse energy credit. Missing or invalid proofs mean no vote that epoch. Colluding meter operators can forge readings; power use does not prove water quality, and wealth can buy many IDs.
